commands.title: Select File Group for the Current File

drools.lsp.grouping.markdownDescription: Declares which DRL files are grouped together for completion, navigation and validation, without needing a file on disk. Same shape as `drl-lsp-kbases.json`, and takes precedence over one. Leave empty to use `META-INF/kmodule.xml` and any `drl-lsp-kbases.json` in the workspace instead.

kbases.description: Groups declared directly. Use 'packages' for kmodule-style package patterns, or 'files' to list paths explicitly.

files.description: Paths belonging to this group, in order. Relative entries resolve against the workspace root.

includes.description: Names of other groups whose packages this group also claims.

name.description: The group's name, as shown in the status bar.

packages.markdownDescription: Package patterns, with `kmodule.xml` semantics: `*`, `com.example.*`, and a leading `!` to exclude. **The first pattern that matches decides**, so list exclusions before the wildcard they carve out of.

sources.description: Adopts rule manifests the project already has, without editing them.

aliases.description: Maps each canonical key to the key(s) the existing files use. Several source keys may map onto one canonical key, concatenating their values.

include.description: Glob matching the manifest files to read, relative to the workspace root.

pathsRelativeTo.description: Directories that relative paths in those manifests resolve against. Globs allowed. Omit to anchor each manifest at its own directory.

drools.lsp.inlayHints.enabled.markdownDescription: Show inline type hints for DRL rule bindings (e.g. `$count : count()` → `: Long`). VSCode's global `#editor.inlayHints.enabled#` still governs whether inlay hints are displayed at all.

drools.lsp.java.packageFilters.markdownDescription: Package prefixes limiting which Java source types are indexed, e.g. `com.example.*`. Empty means all packages. Applied when the language server next starts.

drools.lsp.java.sourcePaths.markdownDescription: Java source roots used to resolve the project's own types before a build, each absolute or workspace-relative. Maven-convention roots (`src/main/java`) are always discovered; entries here are added to that. Applied when the language server next starts.

drools.lsp.lint.missingEnd.description: Severity for the missing 'end' keyword lint check.

drools.lsp.lint.missingSemicolon.description: Severity for the missing semicolon in consequence lint check.

drools.lsp.lint.missingSeparator.description: Severity for the missing constraint separator lint check (missing comma between constraints).

drools.lsp.lint.mvelPropertyAccess.description: Severity for the MVEL property-access style hint (prefer 'name' over 'getName()' in LHS constraints).

drools.lsp.lint.unbalancedParens.description: Severity for the unbalanced parentheses lint check.

drools.lsp.lint.unknownTypes.description: Severity for unrecognized type references in patterns, 'new T(...)' and qualified names, with a 'Did you mean?' quick-fix for likely typos.

drools.lsp.logLevel.description: Server-side log level (java.util.logging). Use FINE or FINER to surface diagnostics when debugging.

drools.lsp.maven.pomPath.markdownDescription: Maven POM(s) used for dependency classpath resolution — a single path or a list of paths, each absolute or workspace-relative. Each project's classpath is resolved and the results are merged. Leave empty to use `pom.xml` at the workspace root.
